title: Count Reconciliation Worksheet, 21:00: Three Counts, One Bus

fields.heading: LRMC MEDCOM: COUNT RECONCILIATION WORKSHEET, CAD 26-118342, HWY 21 AT COUNTY ROAD K, 21:00
fields.source: LRMC MEDCOM clerk, compiled at 21:00 from the scene tag list (Triage Leader), the paper transport log, the MED 1 door counts from 20:50, the CAD notes, and the calls and posts received 21:02–21:04. STATUS: WORKING COPY. THE IC HAS NOT APPROVED A COUNT AND MEDCOM HAS NOT CONFIRMED ONE.

rows: LC-0412 changed from Delayed to Immediate on reassessment. LC-0428 was Expectant and is now Deceased (20:22).
Includes LC-0402, LC-0405, LC-0409 and LC-0425 (cut free 19:58).
LC-0412 at 19:38 after voice confirmation. LC-0417 is one of the 2 Delayed.
LC-0417, Oxbow Medic 41, 18:36. A second entry for LC-0417 at 18:52 reads 'redirected to St. Brendan's.'
TRANSPORT LOG: Minor injury site, Brandt Lake HS (transit bus)
7 on the first transit bus; last 4 on the second bus, loaded after 20:30.
LC-0428, covered in place in the treatment area. A paramedic stays with him. Medical Examiner controls the body.
Delayed count is 1 higher than B1.
Arrived by private car, no scene tags. 7 still in the ED, 2 discharged (20:50).

MVC, MINOR REAR-END, Highway 21 southbound at the State Patrol closure south of County Road K. Trooper reports 3 occupants with neck and back pain who declined EMS and drove themselves to Pinecrest Memorial. Not involved in the bus crash.
PHONE 21:02: Tri-County Coach Lines safety manager

"The manifest shows 31 passengers and the driver. Six of the names on our list match the names Pinecrest gave the Red Cross. Our tanker-side contact says the tanker driver drove himself to LRMC around 19:40."
"Still 40 hurt per Channel 9 and NOBODY from the county will say if someone died. Pinecrest says 9, LRMC won't talk. Hwy 21 still shut, I've been sitting here 3 hrs #Hwy21Crash"
"We're updating at 21:30. Give us one number, and is it true someone died?"

instructorNote: This page adds pressure on the count. MEDCOM and the Medical Group should reach 35 crash patients: 28 tagged, plus 6 bus passengers who walked in to Pinecrest, plus the tanker driver as LRMC's 7th Delayed. They should list the 3 rear-end walk-ins from CAD 26-118356 and the firefighter separately, and mark LC-0417 as a redirect, not a second patient. Watch for one IC-approved, MEDCOM-confirmed number before 21:30, released through the JIC with 1 death confirmed and no name (the Medical Examiner controls identification), a statement that the number may change, and families sent to the Brandt Lake HS reunification center and the call-in line.
